name: Chin-up

phases.name: pull
phases.cue: Pull your elbows down in front of you

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower slowly to a dead hang

formTips: Grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart
Start from a dead hang with your arms long and shoulders pulled down
Pull your elbows down in front of your ribs until your chin reaches the bar
Lower slowly all the way back to straight arms
For an assisted chin-up, loop a band under your feet or knees, or use the assisted machine, and keep the same form
commonMistakes: Kicking or swinging the legs to get up
Stopping halfway instead of returning to straight arms
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
Craning the neck to get the chin over the bar
